tip: Present participles like leende (smiling) end in -ande or -ende and keep one form no matter the noun.
Just here means just now. It sits between har and kommit to say something happened moments ago.
Vart means where to, for direction. Var means where something sits. Vart vinden blåser asks which way.
Säga åt någon att means tell someone to do something. The åt is required: sa åt mig att vänta.
When the question word is the subject, add som: vem som hade ringt, never vem hade ringt.
Swedish says ha rätt, literally have right, to mean be correct: han hade rätt, he was right.
Front an adverbial like Enligt honom and the verb comes next, before the subject: var det, not det var.
